user_query: Identify the enzyme family and provide the best-supported catalytic activity, chemical reaction, cofactors, pathway context, and confidence. Use sequence-derived analysis plus curated Swiss-Prot homolog annotations; distinguish direct evidence from homology-based inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Catalyzes the reductive methylation of 2'-deoxyuridine-5'-monophosphate (dUMP) to 2'-deoxythymidine-5'-monophosphate (dTMP) while utilizing 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate (mTHF) as the methyl donor and reductant in the reaction, yielding dihydrofolate (DHF) as a by-product. This enzymatic reaction provides an intracellular de novo source of dTMP, an essential precursor for DNA biosynthesis.
